name: Confidence Engine & Evaluators
description: Per-task quality tracking Facade/orchestrator. Maintains a rolling window of comparison-pair samples per task, computes correlation scores using task-specific evaluators, detects drift (gradual degradation) and shift (sudden quality drops), derives current phase from confidence metrics via the phase manager, and exposes frozen ConfidenceSnapshot objects for downstream consumers. Implemented as a composition-root-friendly class with three injected dependencies: EvaluatorRegistry (from evaluators), a factory for RollingComparisonWindow instances (from rolling_window), and phase evaluation functions (from phase_manager). Phase is NEVER stored — always recomputed from current window metrics plus externally-provided training example counts. Evaluator failures are caught and logged, never propagated. All state flows through explicit parameters or injected dependencies; no global state.

types.name: ConfidenceEngineConfig

fields.name: window_size
fields.description: Maximum number of comparison-pair samples per task rolling window. Applies to all task types uniformly.

fields.name: max_window_age_seconds
fields.description: Maximum age in seconds of the oldest sample in a window before the window is considered stale and a coaching sample is overdue. Default is 72 hours (259200 seconds).

fields.name: trend_sensitivity
fields.description: Threshold for detecting a sudden quality shift. If the absolute difference between the current window aggregate score and the previous snapshot score exceeds this value in a single evaluation, a shift event is flagged. Must be in (0.0, 1.0).

fields.name: trend_window_size
fields.description: Number of most recent comparison pairs used for trend (slope) computation within each rolling window. Must be >= 2.

fields.name: task_evaluator_configs
fields.description: Mapping from task_id (str) to EvaluatorConfig (from evaluators dependency). Determines which evaluator is used for each task type. Every task_id encountered at runtime must have an entry here; missing entries cause a configuration error at record_comparison time.

fields.name: phase_thresholds
fields.description: PhaseThresholds configuration (from phase_manager dependency), serialized as a dict. Validated via phase_manager.validate_thresholds at engine construction time. Keys: phase1_to_phase2_example_count, phase2_to_phase3_threshold, coaching_trigger, emergency_threshold, sustained_window_count.

fields.name: persistence_dir
fields.description: Directory path for persisting rolling window state as JSON files. One file per task_id. Created on first persist_state call if it does not exist.

validators.error_message: persistence_dir must be a non-empty string

types.description: Frozen Pydantic v2 configuration model for the ConfidenceEngine. Validated strictly at construction time (fail fast). Contains window parameters, drift/shift detection sensitivity, per-task evaluator configs, phase thresholds, and persistence directory. Immutable after construction.

types.name: EvaluationOutcome

fields.name: task_id
fields.description: Identifier of the task type for which this evaluation was performed.

fields.name: score
fields.description: Evaluation score in [0.0, 1.0] if evaluation succeeded, None if the evaluator failed. When None, the error field is populated.

fields.name: evaluator_type
fields.description: Identifier of the evaluator that was used (or attempted). Matches the EvaluatorConfig type discriminator for the task.

fields.name: error
fields.description: Human-readable error message if evaluation failed. None on success. Suitable for structured logging.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: ISO-8601 formatted UTC-aware datetime of when this evaluation was performed.

validators.error_message: timestamp must be ISO-8601 UTC-aware format

fields.name: added_to_window
fields.description: True if the comparison pair was successfully added to the rolling window, False if evaluation failed or the result was discarded.

types.description: Pydantic v2 model representing the result of a single record_comparison call. Contains the evaluation score (if successful), the evaluator type used, an optional error message (if the evaluator failed), and the timestamp. When evaluation fails, score is None and error is populated; the failed evaluation is NOT added to the rolling window.

types.name: DriftShiftStatus

fields.name: drift_detected
fields.description: True if the trend direction is DEGRADING over recent consecutive windows, indicating gradual quality degradation.

fields.name: shift_detected
fields.description: True if the absolute change in aggregate correlation score from the previous snapshot exceeds trend_sensitivity, indicating a sudden quality change.

fields.name: score_delta
fields.description: Signed difference between the current aggregate score and the previous snapshot score. Positive = improvement, negative = degradation. None if no previous snapshot exists.

types.description: Diagnostic struct indicating whether drift (gradual degradation) or shift (sudden quality drop) has been detected for a task. Computed during get_snapshot by comparing current aggregate score and trend against thresholds.

types.name: ConfidenceSnapshotEnriched

fields.name: task_type
fields.description: Task type identifier.

fields.name: correlation_score
fields.description: Current rolling aggregate correlation score in [0.0, 1.0]. None if the window is empty (no samples yet).

fields.name: training_example_count
fields.description: Training example count as provided by the caller. Used for phase derivation.

fields.name: sample_count
fields.description: Number of comparison-pair samples currently in the rolling window.

fields.name: consecutive_windows_above_threshold
fields.description: Number of consecutive get_snapshot calls where correlation_score >= phase2_to_phase3_threshold. Tracked internally by the engine to feed into phase_manager sustained-period logic.

fields.name: trend_direction
fields.description: Trend direction string: 'IMPROVING', 'STABLE', or 'DEGRADING'. Derived from rolling window trend computation.

fields.name: is_stale
fields.description: True if the oldest sample in the window exceeds max_window_age, indicating a coaching sample is overdue. False if not stale. Defaults to False when window is empty.

fields.name: phase
fields.description: Derived phase string: 'REMOTE_ONLY', 'COACHING', or 'AUTONOMOUS'. Always recomputed from current metrics, never stored.

fields.name: drift_shift_status
fields.description: Drift and shift detection diagnostics for this snapshot.

fields.name: window_size
fields.description: Configured maximum window size for this task's rolling window.

fields.name: phase_transition
fields.description: If a phase transition occurred (derived phase differs from the last-known phase for this task), contains the PhaseTransition audit event as a dict. None if no transition occurred.

types.description: Extended snapshot combining the phase_manager ConfidenceSnapshot fields with engine-level drift/shift diagnostics and the derived phase. This is the primary output of get_snapshot. Frozen Pydantic v2 model.

types.name: OptionalPhaseTransitionDict

functions.name: __init__
functions.description: Constructs the ConfidenceEngine with validated configuration and injected dependencies. Validates ConfidenceEngineConfig strictly (fail fast on invalid config). Validates phase_thresholds via phase_manager.validate_thresholds. Stores the EvaluatorRegistry, window factory parameters, and phase evaluation function references. Initializes empty internal state: task-to-window map, task-to-last-known-phase map (all tasks start as REMOTE_ONLY), task-to-consecutive-windows-above-threshold counters, and task-to-previous-score map for shift detection. No file I/O is performed during construction; use load_state to restore persisted windows.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Validated configuration for the engine. Must pass all field validators and cross-field validation (phase threshold ordering).

inputs.name: evaluator_registry
inputs.description: EvaluatorRegistry.evaluators dict mapping evaluator type names to evaluator instances satisfying the Evaluator protocol. Built by evaluators.build_evaluator_registry at the composition root.

inputs.name: logger
inputs.description: Python stdlib logging.Logger instance for structured JSON audit logging. If None, a default logger named 'apprentice.confidence_engine' is created.

functions.name: record_comparison
functions.description: Records a comparison between a local model response and a remote model response for a given task. Resolves the evaluator for the task from the registry, calls evaluate() with internally-constructed TaskResponse objects, and on success creates a ComparisonPair and adds it to the task's rolling window. On evaluator failure, logs the error at WARNING level and returns a degraded EvaluationOutcome with score=None and the error message — the failed evaluation is NOT added to the rolling window. If no rolling window exists for the task_id, one is lazily created with the engine's configured window_size and max_window_age_seconds. The timestamp is generated as datetime.now(timezone.utc) in ISO-8601 format.

functions.name: get_snapshot
functions.description: Computes and returns an enriched confidence snapshot for a single task. Retrieves the aggregate correlation score from the task's rolling window, computes trend via the window's get_trend method, checks staleness, builds a phase_manager ConfidenceSnapshot, calls phase_manager.evaluate to derive the current phase, detects drift (trend is DEGRADING) and shift (score delta exceeds trend_sensitivity), and assembles the final ConfidenceSnapshotEnriched. If the task has no rolling window (never recorded a comparison), returns a snapshot with correlation_score=None, sample_count=0, phase=REMOTE_ONLY, no drift/shift. Internally tracks consecutive_windows_above_threshold per task and the previous aggregate score per task for shift detection. Logs phase transitions at INFO or WARNING level when the derived phase differs from the last-known phase for this task.

inputs.description: Task type identifier to compute the snapshot for.

inputs.name: example_count
inputs.description: Current number of training examples accumulated for this task type. Provided by the caller (e.g., the training data store). Used for phase 1→2 transition logic.

inputs.name: local_model_available
inputs.description: Whether a local model is currently available for this task. If False, phase is forced to REMOTE_ONLY regardless of metrics.

functions.name: get_all_snapshots
functions.description: Computes and returns enriched confidence snapshots for all known tasks (i.e., all tasks that have either a rolling window from prior record_comparison calls or load_state, OR are declared in task_evaluator_configs). Calls get_snapshot for each task with the provided example counts and local model availability flags. Tasks not present in example_counts default to example_count=0. Tasks not present in local_model_availability default to local_model_available=False.

inputs.name: example_counts
inputs.description: Mapping from task_id (str) to training example count (int). Tasks not present in this map are assumed to have 0 training examples.

inputs.name: local_model_availability
inputs.description: Mapping from task_id (str) to local_model_available (bool). Tasks not present in this map are assumed to have no local model available (False).

functions.name: persist_state
functions.description: Persists the rolling window state for all tasks to disk as JSON files. Each task's window is persisted to a separate file: {persistence_dir}/{task_id}.json. Uses the rolling_window.persist method which performs atomic file writes (temp file + os.replace). Creates the persistence_dir if it does not exist. Persistence failures are logged at WARNING level and do NOT raise exceptions — the engine continues operating with in-memory state. This method is caller-controlled and should be called periodically or at shutdown.

functions.name: load_state
functions.description: Loads persisted rolling window state from disk for all tasks that have JSON files in the persistence_dir. For each {task_id}.json file found, loads the window via rolling_window.load and populates the internal task-to-window map. Existing in-memory windows are overwritten by loaded state. Tasks with no persisted file are not affected. Files that fail to load (corrupted, invalid schema, unsupported version) are logged at WARNING level and skipped — the engine continues with whatever state it has. Should be called once at startup after __init__ and before processing requests.

invariants: Phase is NEVER stored as persistent state — always recomputed from current window metrics, training example count, and local model availability via phase_manager.evaluate
Evaluator failures are caught and logged, never propagated as exceptions to callers of record_comparison; a degraded EvaluationOutcome with score=None is returned instead
Failed evaluations are never added to the rolling window — only successful evaluations produce ComparisonPair entries
One RollingComparisonWindow instance per task_id; windows are created lazily on first record_comparison or loaded from disk via load_state
All internal state (window map, last-known-phase map, consecutive-windows counters, previous-score map) is instance-scoped — no global state
Config is immutable after __init__ — validated strictly at construction time per fail-fast policy
Every phase transition is logged as a structured JSON audit event via stdlib logging
consecutive_windows_above_threshold is incremented when correlation_score >= phase2_to_phase3_threshold and reset to 0 otherwise, tracked per-task within the engine
Persistence is explicit and caller-controlled; no automatic file writes on record_comparison
All public methods that read from rolling windows are thread-safe via the window's internal threading.Lock
Drift is detected when trend_direction is DEGRADING; shift is detected when absolute score delta from previous snapshot exceeds trend_sensitivity
All datetime values use UTC timezone; naive datetimes are never produced or accepted
The engine can operate with zero persisted state — all tasks start with empty windows and REMOTE_ONLY phase
ConfidenceSnapshotEnriched is a frozen Pydantic model — immutable after construction
